_comment: Single Source of Truth for Inflatable Pool Factory pool brand facts.
All numbers and facts on pages, llms.txt and JSON-LD render from this file.
2026-10: rebranded to inflatable swimming pools only. Contact: info@inflatablepoolfactory.com.

brand.name: Inflatable Pool Factory
brand.slogan: Premium Drop Stitch Inflatable Swimming Pools
brand.description: Inflatable Pool Factory is a premium drop stitch inflatable pool brand by the Inflatable Pool Team at Qingdao Vatrad Group — rectangular and round pools with rigid walls that set up in minutes and fold away for winter storage. Pressure and leak-test requirements, applicable standards, and compliance documentation are confirmed per product and project.

quality.inspectionStandard: Inspection points, sampling and acceptance criteria are confirmed in the approved inspection plan

pressureTest.method: Pressure and leak-test method, hold time and test pressure are confirmed in the approved production specification

quality.testCoverage: Production units are checked against the approved specification

commercial.moqPools: Standard program 1 pc (mixed models accepted); OEM logo 5 pcs; full custom development 20 pcs
commercial.samplingLeadTimeDays: 7 days for stock platforms / 15 days for customized samples; sample fee refunded at 30 pcs cumulative orders
commercial.productionLeadTimeDays: 45 days off-season / up to 60 days in peak season (January–April), from deposit and confirmed artwork
commercial.paymentTerms: 30% T/T deposit, 70% against B/L copy; T/T and L/C accepted; PayPal accepted for samples
commercial.incoterms: FOB Qingdao standard; CIF and DDP on request
commercial.warrantyPool: 2-year limited warranty on pool fabric, seams, and valves
commercial.warrantyNote: 2-year limited warranty covers drop stitch fabric integrity, seam air-holding capability, inflation valves, and accessories
